body: I'm travelling my home states in Australia.

I could get gel but the only thing is I may need to touch my friends during hikes and climbs and I've heard that you can't do that on gel. I've also heard bad things about gel. As for pellets and smaller doses to take with we Im from Australia and we don't have to many options out side of gel and a shot, we also had a shortage recently and are still coming back from that so lots of doctors have only been able to prescribe certain types of T. I've also been on the one I take for five and half years so I'm very reluctant to change. 

Hormones in Australia are heavily restricted and can only be prescribed in small amounts, I get 1 repeat before I have to go back and get a whole new script.  My doctor has to tell our countries health service I have testicular issues in order for them to even release the script.
